label: obtrapezoid
definition: A trapezoid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being trapezoid in outline with the longer of the two parallel sides at the apex.
reason: The inverted form of PATO:0002044 trapezoid, made the same way as FLOPO:0991185 obtriangular under triangular. Used for lobes, stigmas and stipules.
The label is a transcription fault: the examples are ordinary stamen lengths ('± 1,5 mm de long'), which the measurement already covers.

label: napiform
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being turnip-shaped: broader than long, swollen above and abruptly narrowed below into a slender tip.
reason: A standard term for roots and tubers with no PATO term. It sits beside FLOPO:0991109 tuberous and is more specific than fusiform or conical.
Univittate means one vitta (oil canal) in each furrow of the fruit, which is a count of parts. The bearers in the data (petal, whole plant) are wrong; the vittae are in the fruit.
Refracted pedicels are abruptly bent backward, which matches the PATO definition of reflexed (bent at an angle backward or abaxially).
'Sub-' plus an existing value: the approximate-value pattern, with the whole word as the cue.

label: suffrutescent
definition: A texture quality inhering in a plant or stem by virtue of its being woody only at the base, the upper parts remaining herbaceous and dying back each season.
reason: The habit of a subshrub has no PATO or FLOPO term (PATO has no woody quality). It is a texture quality, like FLOPO:0991126 corky. The '-ulose' ending is a weakened form, so a '± suffrutescent' reading would also be fair.
Describes the rim of lichen apothecia (no corona). These parts are not in PO or FLOPO anatomy, and lichens are outside the ontology.
Allium bulb coats whose cells do not form a net pattern: the negation of FLOPO:0991100 reticulate, which already covers network patterns of a surface.
A plain negation of the existing value marcescent.

label: synoecious
definition: A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a bryophyte gametophyte by virtue of its bearing antheridia and archegonia mixed together in the same gametoecium.
reason: A bryophyte sexual system with no term. It is a sibling of FLOPO:0991093 autoicous, which has the same parent.
Matted, intertwined hairs that form a felt are PATO pannose, whose synonym is felted. 'Cobwebby' only says the felt is thin.
States that the anther has no pollen.
A comparison ('identical to those of the male flowers') whose second term is not kept here, like 'similar' in the previous review.
